fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.behavior: Corpus node x/y values are ignored. The selected node is fixed at (420,335); direct neighbors are placed around an ellipse centered near (420,315) with radii 280 and 235.
fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.impact: Adding seven total nodes does not itself change map geometry. The largest current direct degree is 8; the proposed rectangle-cover node has degree 5, so this design does not increase that maximum.

fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.behavior: The SVG viewBox and dotted background rectangle are both fixed at 840 by 660.
fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.impact: No change is required on current degree evidence. If root changes bounds, both literals must change together.

fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.behavior: Edge directions normalize the center-to-center vector and shorten endpoints by 34 and 36 units.
fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.impact: All new nodes need at least one edge. No self-edge may enter, because a zero-length vector would yield invalid coordinates and the validator already rejects self-relations.

fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.behavior: Labels wrap greedily above 24 characters and begin 48 units below the computed node center, with 20 units per extra line.
fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.impact: Functionally assert that generated label coordinates remain within declared bounds for every selectable new node. This does not constitute visual-quality review.

fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.behavior: Cluster names index a fixed colors object without a fallback.
fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.impact: Use existing foundations/algorithms clusters as designed or add a color before using a new cluster; assert every node cluster is present in colors.

fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.behavior: x and y remain public presentation metadata even though the current renderer does not consume them.
fixed_svg_and_coordinate_assumptions.impact: Assign finite numeric metadata values and validate type, but do not require them to fit the current dynamic viewBox.

functional_layout_checks: For every node selected in turn, all computed circle centers and shortened edge endpoints are finite.
Every computed circle center remains inside the 840-by-660 viewBox.
Every generated text baseline from wrapLabel remains inside the declared vertical bound, or the implementation adjusts the bound and background together.
Every node cluster resolves to a color.
No claim of responsive, aesthetic or screenshot-based visual QA follows from these coordinate checks.
conclusion: Only the atlas declaration, Python validator equality check, TypeScript atlas schema type and data-model version belong to the curated schema migration. All other 1.0 schemas are independent or historical and must remain unchanged.
